[[File:Elidinis' ward (f) detail.png|left|150px]]
'''Elidinis' ward (f)''' is a magical shield requiring 80 [[Magic]], [[Defence]], and [[Prayer]] to equip. The fortified ward provides an additional 2% [[magic damage]], 5 Magic Attack and 1 Prayer over the [[arcane spirit shield]]. Its defence bonuses are identical to the arcane spirit shield.

The ward is fortified by attaching an [[arcane sigil]] to [[Elidinis' ward]], requiring level 90 [[Prayer]], 90 [[Smithing]], and 10,000 [[soul rune]]s, granting 260 experience in both skills in the process. Boosts can be used for the Prayer and Smithing level requirements to fortify the ward; players '''cannot''' pay [[Abbot Langley]] to fortify it for them, though he can remove the sigil from an arcane spirit shield. Upon fortifying Elidinis' ward, the chatbox states "''You fuse your Arcane sigil to Elidinis' ward, returning it to its former glory."''

The fortified ward is untradeable, but it can be dismantled to return the sigil and ward. However, the soul runes will not be returned.

A [[Menaphite ornament kit]] can be attached to the ward to create [[Elidinis' ward (or)]], a cosmetic variant of the ward.
